state.background:
# Stage 5 of 5 requirements

Only the changes are listed. A CHANGED rule says which part of an earlier rule it replaces; every other earlier rule, obligation and exception stays in force.

## Changes

- [NEW] Record limit: params may contain 'max_records', an int of at least 1. Export only the first max_records records (in ascending id order) that remain after every other rule. The JSON object must also have the key "truncated": true if this limit left out at least one record, otherwise false (also when max_records is absent).

Visible tests for the rules introduced or changed in this stage only: /task/fixtures/current-tests/test_stage.py (replaced at each stage). Earlier rules still apply and are checked by the hidden evaluation.

items.text: [REVIEW: possibly affected by newer stage, see CHANGED rules] Stage1 done in exporter/core.py: CSV header id,title,owner,amount (csv.writer, lt \n, asc id); viewer->PermissionError; admin all projects, others only user[projects]; only active unless params include_archived is True. Helper ctxhelper.update(new_req_text,{id:body}) uses jev to flag notes.

Stage2 done: confidential True skipped unless admin & purpose=='audit'; params since 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> created>=since (string cmp first 10 chars). OBLIGATION: if format changes from CSV, add top-level 'exported_by'=user['name'] unless withdrawn.

Stage3 done: output json.dumps({'records':[{id int,title,owner,amount str}] asc id, 'exported_by': user['name']}) (stage2 obligation fulfilled). CSV format replaced (historical: stage1 CSV header id,title,owner,amount).
Stage4 done: non-admin (non-viewer) also gets records with owner==user['name'] even outside projects. Viewer/admin rules unchanged; rest of stage1 permission rule in force.
